situation: Small German family foundry for which we are a big customer (7.1 % of turnover). It bought power forward to Dec 2028 and has covered material to Dec 2028, so it offers a price fixed until then. Market-energy arguments are 'not our reality' in either direction. The casing cover is priced exactly at should-cost (33.94 vs 33.93); the HB 40 housing (43.39) carries margin and is 35 % above Tarsevi. It is the qualified backup for three distressed suppliers' parts (310011, 310020, 310030), on our tooling.
